_readme: Photos for the homepage story. Drop your photos in images/plates/ and put their paths here. A beat switches from the drawing to your photos as soon as ALL of its paths are filled in; until then the drawing is shown. Every before/after pair must be shot from the same locked camera position (tripod, same zoom). Landscape 3:2 works best, at least 2000 px wide; if you also save a smaller copy for phones (same name ending in -1200.jpg, 1200 px wide), set "phoneSizes" to true. Write a short 'alt' description of what the photo shows. The kitchen and deck already point at placeholder files ("PHOTO COMING"): overwrite those files with your photos (same names), then change "use" from false to true.

forest-hill.alt: A tree-lined street in Forest Hill.

house.alt: The full house: three floors, garage built into the ground floor.

siding.alt: The siding and trim, before and after painting.

door.alt: The front door, before and after painting.

garage.alt: The garage door, before and after painting.

walls.alt: The kitchen: dated beige walls and cabinets, then bright white.

fence.alt: The fence, before and after staining.

deck.alt: The deck and balcony: weathered, pressure washed, sanded, then stained.
